(2) STU-COL-218 interpolation for table models: color::solve already blends ColorMatrix and ForwardMatrix by the solved scene CCT (mired-linear between the two calibration illuminants, A 2856 K and D65 6504 K); now proved: unit test table_profiles_interpolate_between_their_two_illuminants_by_cct (R6: weight ~0 at the A white, ~1 at the D65 white (cct 6503), strictly inside and mired-linear between, camera matrix = weight blend of the two ForwardMatrices x WB diagonal to 1e-9); corpus: R6 as-shot solves cct 4446 K, weight 0.638 (asserted strictly between); harness CR3 import asserts 2856 < cct < 6504 and 0 < weight < 1 in the receipt
